QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I list my salon on the platform?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Contact us and get the oboarding guide, that instructs you on how to provide accurate salon details, upload photos, list your services, and set your availability. Our step-by-step onboarding guide makes it simple.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I manage my appointments through the platform?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, you can view, confirm, reschedule, or cancel appointments directly through the platform. You’ll also receive notifications for new bookings.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I set my services, prices, and durations?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You can add, edit, or remove services at any time in your profile. Set the price, duration, and any special notes for each service to reflect your offerings accurately.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I manage multiple staff members?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: No, the platform is meant for individual service providers. The goal is to level the playing field with big franchises using data and statistics to leverage structural expertise

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I handle cancellations or no-shows?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: The platform automatically bans no-shows and may apply custom cancellation mark-up fee's for future appointments.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Will I get paid through the platform?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: No, at the moment, the platform does not process payments. You receive payments directly from clients at the salon.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I offer promotions or discounts?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You can create special offers, or package deals to attract new clients and or retain existing ones.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I manage client information?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: The platform provides a secure client management system. You can view booking history, contact details, and notes for each client while maintaining privacy compliance.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I track my salon’s performance?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes. While our current dashboards offer essential insights, we are actively rolling out frequent updates to provide a more robust experience. Soon, you’ll have access to comprehensive metrics—including revenue, popular services, locale rankings, and recurring client behaviour. All designed to help you scale your business.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Is there customer support if I need help?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, the platform offers dedicated support for owners, including video tutorials, documentation, and email assistance for any issues or questions.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What services can I book through the platform?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: You can book a wide range of services including haircuts, styling, coloring, facials, manicures, pedicures, massage therapy, skincare treatments, depilations, and more.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I find a salon near me?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Use the location search feature to find all services in your area.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I book multiple services in one appointment?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, many salons allow you to book multiple services in a single appointment. Check the salon’s profile for available packages for service combinations.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: How do I pay for my appointment?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: In person with the service provider. The platform does not process payments due to our belief that a payment processing platform has maladjusted incentives to algorithmically take advantage of service providers.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Can I book an appointment for someone else?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Yes, you can schedule appointments for family or friends by providing their details during the booking process.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Do salons offer loyalty programs or discounts?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Many salons provide loyalty rewards or promotional offers. Check the individual salon’s profile for available deals.

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: Is my personal information safe?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: Absolutely. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information

QUESTIONS.QUESTION: What should I do if I encounter an issue with my booking?
QUESTIONS.ANSWER: If you experience any issues, contact the salon directly through the platform or reach out to our customer support team for assistance.
